notes.title: Patch Note #2 Singleplayer mode, effects combinations and more
notes.notes:
Hello! We are glad to present you our first major update! Take a look on the list of new features!
[list]
[*][b]Effects combinations.[/b] We added possibility to combine effects from different pick-ups with each other! It means that from now on you can wreck your opponent’s gameplay even more. But remember that this rule applies to you as well. 
[*][b]AI implementation.[/b] You asked – we delivered. We understand that some players can be dissatisfied because of the fact, that they can’t find opponent to play with in a quick match. But now even if you don’t have a friend to invite – you can easily test your skills by playing against AI opponents. They have 5 difficulty levels. And we warn you – the last one is completely unfair. Defeating him will prove your overwhelming skill level. Very few can do such thing.
[*][b]Extended settings for session.[/b] Now you can change the pool of randomly spawned pick-ups. Want to play First Person Mode only? Or Active power-ups only? Maybe even no-pickups mode? It’s up to you now. 
[*][b]Physics of the puck has been improved.[/b] It feels more responsive to hits, and gameplay is even more fast-paced than before!
[*][b]Added overall graphics options.[/b]
[/list]
Well, don’t hesitate – go and check this out! Share your opinions in discussions, suggest new features that you would like to see in a future updates, and, most importantly, [u]HAVE FUN[/u] and [u]ENJOY THE GAME![/u]

notes.title: Future plans
notes.notes:
Hello to you, stranger! If you are here, then you have some kind of interest in our game. So we would like to tell you everything you need to know about our plans.

First of all, we will deliver updates as frequently as we can. It will include bug fixes, interface usability improvements and new game features. 

[b]Bugs.[/b] If you find any – please message us on the Technical Issues discussion. Provide as complete information as you can and we will eliminate those bugs. We want our game to be satisfying! 

[b]Feature requests.[/b] If you have any of those – message us on the Suggestions discussion. It could be some UI improvements, or game mode request – doesn’t matter. We will check all the requests and try to add them as fast as possible.

[b]Pick-ups ideas.[/b] The previous parts are intended to make you comfortable. But we want you to have fun as well. We don’t want our players to feel bored after a couple of hours spent. So we will add new pick-ups as frequently as we can. And we want Community to participate in brain storm. Have any ideas for a new pick-up? Go straight to Suggestions discussion on Community hub and show other people your creativity. We will consider all the suggestions, and, eventually most of them will be added.

Our plans for the upcoming weeks:
[list]
[*][b]Fix existing bugs.[/b] Our game is not perfect, but we won’t stop trying to make it closer to perfection. 
[*][b]Add more pick-ups.[/b] More gameplay content always means better experience, right? 
[*][b]Add customization.[/b] Win a game and get a token. Collect enough of them and get some fancy stuff. Stay tuned.
[*][b]Keep working on the feature requests.[/b] We already have some results and they are coming live very soon. 
[/list]
